Town opens new library after a decade of planning

By A. Reporter, 21 November 2026

The town of Exampleton opened its new public library on Saturday, ten years after the project was first proposed.

The building holds 40,000 books and a maker space with two 3D printers.

"This is a place for everyone," the mayor said at the opening.

Opening hours are 9am to 8pm, seven days a week.

Correction: an earlier version misstated the opening hours.
